2086a93116d8e9af99d8311e80d1eaec3970333c.issues: Uses simulated rather than real satellite imagery. Baselines are coarse, and skill relative to NWP is not established in the abstract.

f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.goal: Improves precipitation nowcasting (up to two hours) by avoiding the blurring of deterministic deep learning and the limits of advection methods for nonlinear events.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.architecture: Deep Generative Model of Rainfall (DGMR): a conditional GAN with spatial and temporal discriminators that produces ensembles of radar precipitation fields.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.data: UK radar composite (roughly 2016-2019) for training and evaluation, with additional tests on US radar.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.result: Gives realistic, skillful probabilistic nowcasts at 5-90 min leads over regions up to 1536 x 1280 km. In an evaluation by more than 50 Met Office meteorologists, it ranked first in 89% of cases.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.open_work: Extend lead times, improve heavy-rain skill further and integrate with NWP for longer horizons.
f99de990f791799df398fcd38034c4b395d9b7e0.issues: CSI gains over baselines are modest for some thresholds. Skill drops at long leads, and GAN ensembles may be under-dispersed or poorly calibrated in some regimes.

e9c4859bfbba44081245cd4d2a49d6ee4f54bee9.goal: Discusses how digital technologies (HPC, data handling and ML) must transform Earth system science and prediction.
e9c4859bfbba44081245cd4d2a49d6ee4f54bee9.architecture: Perspective covering computing hardware trends, software and programming models, data workflows, ML, and digital twins of the Earth.
e9c4859bfbba44081245cd4d2a49d6ee4f54bee9.result: Argues for co-design of models, software and hardware, wider use of ML and data-centric workflows, and building digital twins that combine high-resolution simulation with observations.
e9c4859bfbba44081245cd4d2a49d6ee4f54bee9.open_work: Implement the vision through large programmes such as Destination Earth.
e9c4859bfbba44081245cd4d2a49d6ee4f54bee9.issues: Perspective without quantitative results. Abstract unavailable, so the summary relies on general knowledge of the paper.

0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.goal: Advances AI-based postprocessing of weather and climate model output, likely the most mature AI application in atmospheric science.
0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.architecture: Review and position paper with proposed actions. It also creates a repository of five archived benchmark datasets with Jupyter notebooks and baseline methods.
0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.data: Five datasets from real weather and climate postprocessing problems (details not given in the abstract).
0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.result: Proposes medium-term goals: trustworthy, interpretable algorithms; FAIR data; and physics-aware techniques. It initiates a shared dataset repository with baselines.
0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.open_work: Encourages the community to test algorithms against the baselines, archive results and expand the repository.
0adcfd0e9c5e8f55b93f40a0fe8537bc68ccc822.issues: Five datasets are a narrow benchmark, and community uptake determines its value.

4ec5b77c02f9a235e8ccfa2b476571b6fff30292.goal: Examines how AI could augment or replace parts of Earth system models and proposes integrating them into hybrid systems.
4ec5b77c02f9a235e8ccfa2b476571b6fff30292.architecture: Perspective that proposes 'neural Earth system modelling': learning, self-validating and interpretable hybrids that combine ESMs and deep neural networks.
4ec5b77c02f9a235e8ccfa2b476571b6fff30292.result: Surveys achievements and limitations of process-based and AI approaches and discusses the potential and pitfalls of neural ESMs.
4ec5b77c02f9a235e8ccfa2b476571b6fff30292.open_work: Leaves open whether AI can bolster ESMs or ultimately make them obsolete; calls for hybrid systems that use observational data streams.
4ec5b77c02f9a235e8ccfa2b476571b6fff30292.issues: Conceptual; offers no implementation or quantitative evidence.

2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.goal: Overcomes the small observational sample size for seasonal forecasting by training ML models on large climate model ensembles.
2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.architecture: Several ML approaches (for example regularized regression, random forests and neural networks) trained on climate model simulations, with interpretability methods to identify physical sources of skill.
2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.data: Thousands of seasons from a large climate model ensemble (CESM large ensemble) for training. Tested on observations from 1980-2020 for western US precipitation patterns and compared with NMME.
2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.result: ML models trained on model simulations match or exceed NMME dynamical models for large-scale western US seasonal precipitation patterns, and interpretability shows physically relevant processes.
2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.open_work: Apply to other regions and variables, and use transfer learning to correct for the training model's biases.
2d5ce8daf478de52d60650c4c1d00e8cb5fbeee0.issues: Inherits biases of the training climate model. Skill is for large-scale patterns in one region, and the observational test sample is small.

9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.goal: Improves deep learning ENSO forecasts by accounting for seasonality, avoiding separate per-season models that give inconsistent forecast time series.
9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.architecture: All-season CNN (A_CNN) that includes calendar-season information in one unified model across target seasons and lead times; activation maps are used for diagnosis.
9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.data: Training and testing follow Ham et al. (2019): CMIP5 historical simulations and reanalysis for training, observations for validation. The details are not given in the abstract.
9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.result: Improves correlation skill of the ENSO index, especially for boreal spring target seasons (the spring predictability barrier). Activation maps show clear time evolution of precursors with lead time.
9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.open_work: Use the model as a diagnostic tool for ENSO precursors, and extend to ENSO diversity and spatial patterns.
9f1dfd2eebd4ed7c2337eef093396f8cd879be4e.issues: Few independent observed ENSO events for validation, and depends on CMIP biases in training data.

0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.goal: Trains hybrid ML and physics forecast models when only noisy, partial observations are available rather than full-state training data.
0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.architecture: Hybrid model in which reservoir computing corrects an imperfect knowledge-based model. Training uses analyses from an Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter.
0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.data: Synthetic observations from the Lorenz 1963 and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky systems, with model error introduced as a misspecified parameter.
0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.result: Training on DA analyses from partial measurements yields an ML correction that improves forecasts of the imperfect model.
0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.open_work: Scale to realistic atmospheric models (pursued in Arcomano et al. 2022) and iterate DA and training cycles.
0aa01ad544b98f5d8429329761f230b9569be5a6.issues: Low-dimensional toy systems and a simple parametric model error. Behaviour with realistic structural error is untested.

671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.goal: Uses ML to understand how circulation changes contribute to trends in US Midwest extreme precipitation.
671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.architecture: CNN classifier of extreme-precipitation circulation patterns (EPCPs) from daily sea level pressure and 500 hPa geopotential height anomalies, with visualization methods for interpretation.
671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.data: Daily reanalysis circulation fields and observed Midwest precipitation extremes over roughly four decades.
671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.result: The CNN identifies 91% of observed extremes. EPCPs have become more frequent over the past two decades, but trends over four decades are insignificant. Moisture transport and precipitation intensity during EPCPs have increased.
671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.open_work: Apply to climate model projections to reduce uncertainty about future changes in extremes.
671a06ac9422c0705e56c4f4f0018fab41141ce4.issues: Short observational record for trends, a single region, and possible false positives from classification on daily maps.

98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.goal: Emulates the shortwave RRTM radiative transfer model at a fraction of its cost so it can serve as an NWP parameterization.
98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.architecture: Knowledge-guided U-net++ networks that predict surface downwelling flux, TOA upwelling flux, net flux and heating-rate profiles.
98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.data: RRTM calculations on atmospheric profiles from many sites. Experiment 1 trains on non-tropical sites and tests on tropical sites; Experiment 2 trains and tests on different sites from all regions.
98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.result: The models run about 10^4 times faster than RRTM. Experiment 2 fixes most deficiencies seen in Experiment 1, but large upper-stratospheric heating-rate errors remain.
98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.open_work: Couple the emulator online in NWP and fix the stratospheric heating-rate errors; extend to longwave radiation.
98700f0c763730132af29658dd43d0b97bf81808.issues: Shortwave only and offline. Biases remain for certain cloud configurations and low zenith angles.

025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.goal: Improves variational data assimilation, which is hard to optimize because observations are not invertibly related to physical states.
025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.architecture: Learned inverse observation operator (neural network mapping observations to states), used to initialize 4D-Var-type optimization and to reformulate the objective in physical space.
025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.data: Lorenz 96 model and a two-dimensional turbulent fluid flow, with synthetic observations.
025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.result: Significantly improves forecast quality for these chaotic systems compared with standard variational DA.
025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.open_work: Scale to realistic NWP observation networks and models, and combine with background error statistics.
025d6f7a4f96dc4a68ea814cd10ff261a7cd604c.issues: Idealized systems and synthetic observations; requires training data of paired observations and states.

50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.goal: Improves the accuracy and resolution of global NWP precipitation forecasts, since key precipitation processes are sub-grid.
50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.architecture: Conditional GAN and VAE-GAN that downscale and correct precipitation forecasts stochastically, producing ensembles of high-resolution fields.
50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.data: ECMWF IFS forecast fields as inputs and high-resolution UK radar (NIMROD) precipitation as ground truth.
50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.result: Matches the statistical skill of state-of-the-art pointwise postprocessing while producing spatially coherent high-resolution maps. Compares favourably on pixelwise and pooled CRPS, power spectra and rank histograms, including heavy rain.
50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.open_work: Extend to other regions (for example East Africa), longer lead times and better calibration for extremes.
50e57da81f5ded46ba85be30b8a2341b475cc599.issues: Limited to one region and lead range. GAN training can be unstable, and calibration for rare extremes is challenging.

19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.goal: Combines ML with a physics-based global atmospheric model to improve weather forecasts and climate simulation.
19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.architecture: CHyPP hybrid: reservoir computing (parallel, localized reservoirs) combined with a low-resolution AGCM (SPEEDY).
19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.data: ERA5 reanalysis used for training and verification.
19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.result: Gives more accurate forecasts than the host AGCM for the first 7-8 days, and longer near the surface. It beats ML-only and linear-regression hybrids, and a 10-year simulation has smaller systematic errors and more realistic variability.
19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.open_work: Apply to higher-resolution models and coupled systems, and train from data assimilation output.
19eec9e58bcae47572e4b7034ec86cb8e2dcf36b.issues: Host model is a coarse, simple AGCM, so gains may not transfer to state-of-the-art models.

36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.goal: Builds subgrid parametrizations that perform well in full simulations (a posteriori), not just on offline (a priori) metrics.
36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.architecture: Neural network subgrid closures for 2D quasi-geostrophic turbulence trained end-to-end through a differentiable solver over model trajectories, compared with a priori supervised training.
36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.data: High-resolution 2D QG turbulence simulations coarse-grained to provide reference trajectories.
36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.result: Closures trained a priori tend to be unstable online. End-to-end closures outperform empirical and data-driven schemes in accuracy and stability and generalize to other flow configurations.
36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.open_work: Adopt differentiable programming in climate models and scale to 3D ocean and atmosphere models.
36767f9e410be055bfa5001947c9a41b539c7ea7.issues: Idealized 2D setting. Requires a differentiable solver, and long unrolled training is costly.

750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.goal: Defines what benchmark datasets for ML in atmospheric sciences should be, since an unclear definition confuses domain scientists.
750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.architecture: Perspective that gives a recipe for building benchmark datasets, plus a list of domain-specific challenges and the benchmarks needed for each.
750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.data: No new data; reviews existing benchmarks (for example WeatherBench) across weather, climate and air quality.
750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.result: Provides a recipe and list of needed benchmarks to make ML efforts more coherent and aimed at key challenges.
750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.open_work: Create the proposed benchmarks and engage ML and HPC communities.
750bd44eac82a20515ac71f65116637a05f74e5a.issues: Conceptual; the list of challenges is non-exclusive, and benchmarks risk narrowing research focus.

7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.goal: Provides a benchmark for ML emulators of climate model responses to emissions, so scenario space can be explored cheaply beyond pattern scaling.
7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.architecture: Benchmark framework with baseline emulators (Gaussian process, random forest, neural network models) that map emissions and concentrations of CO2, CH4 and aerosols to climate fields.
7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.data: NorESM2 simulations from ScenarioMIP, AerChemMIP and DAMIP. Targets are annual mean temperature, diurnal temperature range, precipitation and extreme precipitation.
7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.result: Baseline emulators predict global annual-mean fields for unseen scenarios with reasonable skill. Temperature is emulated much better than precipitation.
7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.open_work: Include physical constraints such as energy conservation directly in emulators, and use emulators for detection and attribution.
7cf73a749124f4b6bf2fa34e30c6210222467ef0.issues: Based on a single ESM, so the benchmark reflects its biases. Annual means only; held-out test scenario is limited.

d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.goal: Extends ML correction of a coarse global atmosphere model toward fine-resolution behaviour to multiple climates and multi-year simulations.
d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.architecture: ML models predict corrective temperature and humidity tendencies and surface radiative fluxes from the column state. Training targets come from nudging the coarse (~200 km) FV3GFS toward coarsened fine-resolution (~25 km) runs.
d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.data: Four 2-year ~25 km FV3GFS simulations with SSTs perturbed by -4, 0, +4 and +8 K.
d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.result: In 5.25-year ML-corrected runs, pattern errors of land precipitation fall by 8-28% and of land surface temperature by 19-25% across climates. Impact on ocean precipitation is neutral.
d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.open_work: Improve ocean precipitation, test coupled ocean configurations, and generalize to unseen climates.
d429551ce97dc576f251af3bb7c20d493342cb89.issues: Prescribed SSTs; reference is a model rather than observations. Short training runs, with no gain over ocean.

cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.goal: Extend neural precipitation forecasting (MetNet-2) to 12 h lead times at high resolution, testing whether learned models can beat operational physics-based NWP for precipitation.
cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.architecture: MetNet-2: a large convolutional neural network with ConvLSTM encoding, dilated convolutions for a large spatial context, and lead-time conditioning, outputting probabilistic precipitation-rate categories.
cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.data: Continental US; inputs include radar (MRMS), GOES-16 satellite imagery and NWP/assimilation fields; targets are radar and gauge-based precipitation estimates.
cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.result: Outperforms operational physics-based models over CONUS (HRRR and the HREF ensemble) for precipitation up to 12 h lead time, while running far faster.
cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.open_work: Extending lead time and variables beyond precipitation, and learning more directly from observations (later pursued in MetNet-3).
cb4f1fb55f4580e9812d5de96365fce67c0ef79b.issues: Regional (CONUS only) and precipitation-only; relies on dense radar networks and NWP inputs; requires large compute to train.

4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.goal: Survey deep learning approaches for analysing and predicting the El Nino-Southern Oscillation, a key source of seasonal-to-interannual predictability.
4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.architecture: Literature review; per the title it covers deep learning methods (likely CNNs, recurrent networks and related models) used for ENSO analysis and prediction.
4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.data: Review; covered studies typically use observations, reanalysis and climate-model (e.g. CMIP) simulations. Not reported in the abstract.
4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.result: Abstract not available; the paper presumably synthesizes reported skill and methods of deep-learning ENSO forecasts.
4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.open_work: Likely includes extending skillful lead times, interpretability and handling limited observational records.
4d3f45cc13b5f15e5925537424fd700bb8735ba4.issues: Content cannot be verified from an abstract; summary is inferred from the title only.

80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.goal: Develop a data-driven global weather forecasting model that steps the full 3D atmospheric state forward and is competitive with operational NWP.
80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.architecture: Graph neural network with an encoder-processor-decoder design mapping the lat-lon grid to an icosahedral mesh; a 6-hour step applied autoregressively over several days.
80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.data: ERA5 reanalysis or GFS forecast data at 1 degree with a small set of variables on multiple pressure levels; also tested with live operational GFS initial conditions.
80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.result: Improves on previous data-driven models for Z500 and T850 and is comparable to operational GFS and ECMWF forecasts when evaluated at 1-degree scales with reanalysis initial conditions.
80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.open_work: Higher resolution, more variables and levels, and better performance from operational (rather than reanalysis) initial conditions.
80d7b9180299ed1954dbc3acde4ad4efa8974e0a.issues: Coarse 1-degree evaluation; comparison favours the model when initialized from reanalysis; forecasts smooth with lead time and are deterministic only.

10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.goal: Build a fast, global, high-resolution (0.25 degree) data-driven weather model that forecasts fine-scale variables like surface wind and precipitation.
10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.architecture: Adaptive Fourier Neural Operator (AFNO) token mixing within a vision-transformer backbone, applied autoregressively with 6-hour steps, plus a separate diagnostic precipitation network.
10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.data: ERA5 at 0.25 degree, about 20 variables; training 1979-2015, validation 2016-2017, testing 2018 onward.
10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.result: Matches ECMWF IFS at short lead times for large-scale variables and beats it for precipitation; produces a week-long forecast in under 2 seconds, enabling ensembles of thousands of members.
10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.open_work: Coupling to more variables and Earth-system components, better probabilistic ensembles and longer lead times.
10194e9d1d6b8ca8870445c990d4933c1dac1125.issues: Skill falls below IFS at longer lead times for many variables; trained and evaluated on ERA5, inheriting its biases; deterministic training gives smoothed forecasts.

0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.goal: Assess whether neural weather models can forecast extreme heat globally on short, medium and subseasonal timescales to support heat-wave warnings.
0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.architecture: Convolutional neural weather models on the cubed sphere trained with candidate losses, including mean squared error and exponential losses that emphasize extremes, plus transfer learning.
0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.data: ERA5 reanalysis, surface temperature anomalies at about 200 km resolution, 1-28 day lead times; compared with persistence and the ECMWF S2S control forecast.
0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.result: Extreme-focused losses significantly improve heat-wave skill with little loss in general skill; a symmetric exponential loss reduces smoothing; the best model beats persistence at all leads and the ECMWF S2S control after two weeks.
0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.open_work: Probabilistic ensembles, higher resolution and comparison with full ensemble S2S systems.
0a0cf06a3b9ec06f614d6f31b2fd40e835b5b109.issues: Coarse resolution; comparison is against a single control forecast rather than the ensemble; regressive skill metrics only.

369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.goal: Make deep-learning downscaling physically consistent by guaranteeing that conservation constraints (e.g. coarse-cell averages) are satisfied.
369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.architecture: Constraint layers (e.g. additive, multiplicative and softmax-based) appended to super-resolution networks, tested across several architectures such as CNNs, GANs and recurrent models.
369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.data: Several climate and weather datasets (including ERA5-based fields), plus satellite and natural-image super-resolution datasets.
369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.result: Hard constraints guarantee conservation and also improve standard predictive metrics across architectures and datasets.
369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.open_work: Extending to more physical constraints, larger upsampling factors and real coarse-model outputs rather than synthetically coarsened data.
369659c099ae35c62f6f72904f32e83bc54597c3.issues: Mostly trained on artificially coarsened data, so transfer to real model outputs is untested; constraints enforce only statistical/conservation relations, not dynamics.

4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.goal: Downscale rainfall, especially extremes, to high resolution over New Zealand with an interpretable deep-learning approach.
4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.architecture: Deep-learning (likely convolutional) statistical downscaling model with interpretability analysis; details not available from an abstract.
4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.data: Not reported in the abstract; presumably coarse reanalysis predictors and high-resolution gridded New Zealand rainfall.
4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.result: Abstract not available; the title suggests skillful high-resolution reproduction of rainfall extremes with interpretable predictor relationships.
4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.open_work: Application to climate-model projections and assessment of extrapolation under climate change.
4ce3cfd81aad9500279ca6ff305ec0780a64480b.issues: Summary inferred from the title only; regional focus and possible underestimation of extremes typical of regression-based downscaling.

a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.goal: Identify state-dependent decadal predictability of SST, i.e. which initial states yield skillful 2-10 year predictions in a noisy climate system.
a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.architecture: Regression neural network that outputs both a prediction and its uncertainty (a predicted distribution); low-uncertainty predictions are used to flag predictable initial states.
a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.data: CESM2 pre-industrial control simulation; SST targets in the North Atlantic and North Pacific.
a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.result: The most confident (low-uncertainty) predictions are more skillful, and skillful initial states correspond to particular phases of Atlantic multidecadal variability and the Interdecadal Pacific Oscillation.
a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.open_work: Applying to observations and forced simulations and testing across models.
a0edb36358fff40f229d5bbdd524288876f25ac4.issues: Single model, pre-industrial control only, so no external forcing; predictability is model-dependent.

1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.goal: Simultaneously bias-correct and downscale coarse global ensemble precipitation forecasts to produce actionable high-resolution probabilistic forecasts.
1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.architecture: CorrectorGAN: a conditional GAN with a custom training procedure and augmented loss that generates ensembles of high-resolution, bias-corrected precipitation.
1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.data: Coarse global ensemble forecasts (ECMWF IFS ensemble via TIGGE) plus other meteorological fields as inputs; high-resolution radar precipitation over the Continental US as ground truth.
1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.result: Beats interpolation, super-resolution-only and CNN baselines and approaches an operational regional high-resolution ensemble (HREF) on probabilistic metrics, running in seconds on one machine.
1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.open_work: Transfer to data-poor regions without radar, and assessment of extremes and longer lead times.
1ce29bda84676270f370c1e74c21cbf7ab9628fc.issues: Trained on radar-rich CONUS; GAN training can be unstable; still slightly below the regional model.

15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.goal: Evaluate how faithfully popular explainable-AI methods explain CNN decisions in geoscience, to guide best practice.
15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.architecture: Intercomparison of XAI attribution methods (e.g. gradient, SmoothGrad, input times gradient, integrated gradients, LRP variants, DeepSHAP) applied to CNNs.
15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.data: An idealized synthetic attribution benchmark with known ground truth, and a CNN predicting the number of atmospheric rivers in climate-simulation snapshots.
15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.result: Reveals issues such as gradient shattering, inability to distinguish attribution sign and insensitivity to zero inputs that can distort interpretation of CNN strategies.
15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.open_work: Further study of XAI fidelity, better baselines, and benchmarks for other architectures and tasks.
15e794037c5025f8d57b9e92e6ee0dee296e7403.issues: Limited to a subset of methods and CNNs; conclusions depend on the benchmark design.

e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.goal: Test whether ML emulators of non-orographic gravity-wave drag generalize out of sample, including to the QBO and to increased CO2.
e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.architecture: Single-column artificial neural networks of varying complexity and input sets emulating a conventional gravity-wave parameterization, coupled online to the host model.
e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.data: Idealized climate model (MiMA) with the Alexander-Dunkerton scheme as target; training on one annual cycle and one QBO phase.
e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.result: Moderately complex networks coupled online generate full QBO cycles, and the climate response to enhanced CO2 matches the physics-based scheme.
e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.open_work: Learning gravity-wave schemes from observational or high-resolution estimates of momentum flux rather than from an existing scheme.
e5d7a18712052e17319fb80e4d0dea161d3bc9bb.issues: Emulates an existing parameterization, so inherits its assumptions; idealized model; sensitivity to architecture and inputs.

900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.goal: Make ML convection parameterizations interpretable by compressing subgrid convective processes into a low-dimensional latent space.
900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.architecture: Variational encoder-decoder (VED) with a 5-node latent space mapping large-scale state to subgrid convective tendencies and radiative outputs.
900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.data: Aquaplanet superparameterized climate model (SPCAM) simulation with explicitly resolved convection.
900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.result: The VED reproduces convective processes about as well as earlier feed-forward networks; latent dimensions separate stable vs deep convection, cirrus vs low cumulus, and shallow convection linked to moisture and surface heating.
900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.open_work: Online coupling, use of the generative properties for stochastic parameterization, and extension to realistic geography.
900532ab21d9a064426bcd7cc88d3567d806715c.issues: Aquaplanet setting only; offline evaluation; latent interpretation is partly subjective.

9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.goal: Test whether non-local (multi-column) inputs improve ML parameterizations of atmospheric subgrid processes compared with single-column ones.
9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.architecture: Neural networks using inputs from 3x3 neighbouring columns, with interpretability analysis and experiments adding vertical velocity or divergence as inputs.
9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.data: Coarse-grained output from high-resolution simulations (SAM, quasi-global aquaplanet) used to derive subgrid tendencies and momentum fluxes.
9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.result: Non-local inputs improve offline predictions, especially for subgrid momentum transport and near fronts and convective instability; much of the gain comes from horizontal divergence, and adding vertical velocity substantially helps.
9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.open_work: Online testing of non-local and vertical-velocity inputs in coupled simulations, as the authors note.
9e65a06e03de69e96042931ac8407d512a206ccc.issues: Offline evaluation only; idealized aquaplanet; non-local inputs may complicate implementation and stability.

41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.goal: Correct both local distributions and spatial patterns of precipitation simulated by an Earth system model, which conventional post-processing cannot do.
41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.architecture: Physically constrained generative adversarial network (cycle-consistent, unpaired) with a layer preserving global precipitation sums.
41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.data: Daily precipitation from the CM2Mc-LPJmL ESM, with reanalysis (ERA5) precipitation as the target; tested on future scenarios.
41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.result: Outperforms existing methods for local distributions, strongly improves spatial patterns and intermittency, removes the double ITCZ, and generalizes to unseen future scenarios via the constraint.
41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.open_work: Application to other ESMs and variables and multivariate consistency.
41d21604f69074c56874735d4809896593d99b9f.issues: Applied to one coarse ESM; correction is statistical and does not fix model dynamics; unpaired mapping complicates verification.

a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.goal: Emulate expensive aerosol microphysics in a global aerosol-climate model to reduce cost while keeping accuracy.
a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.architecture: Neural network emulating M7 microphysics tendencies, with physics-informed variants that reduce mass violation and enforce positivity.
a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.data: Input-output pairs generated by the M7 microphysics module of ECHAM-HAM.
a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.result: Average R^2 of 77.1% on tendencies, and up to over 64x speed-up on a GPU relative to the original model.
a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.open_work: Online coupling into ECHAM-HAM and assessing long-term stability.
a2d5642126dafa9ce5445b2b8a6cfb25d971eeb2.issues: Offline evaluation only; moderate R^2 for some variables; mass conservation only partially enforced.

756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.goal: Improve data-driven ensemble medium-range forecasting by learning how to perturb the model, rather than using ad hoc initial-condition perturbations or MC dropout.
756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.architecture: SwinVRNN: Swin Transformer-based recurrent network (SwinRNN) with a VAE-style perturbation module learning a time-variant latent Gaussian distribution.
756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.data: WeatherBench (ERA5-based) data; comparisons with operational ECMWF IFS.
756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.result: Learned distribution perturbation gives better accuracy and reasonable spread than fixed perturbations, MC dropout or multi-model ensembles; surpasses IFS for 2 m temperature and 6-hourly precipitation up to 5 days.
756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.open_work: Higher resolution, longer lead times and better spread-skill calibration.
756f37b5acbcc464b026dfcafdadbedd87590247.issues: Coarse WeatherBench resolution; comparison against IFS on reanalysis targets; limited lead time.

de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.goal: Enable machine learning inference at scale inside running numerical simulations, demonstrated with ocean climate modelling.
de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.architecture: SmartSim, a software library coupling simulations to ML via an in-memory database, demonstrated with a neural network predicting eddy kinetic energy for an ocean-model mesoscale parameterization.
de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.data: MOM6 global ocean simulations; network trained on higher-resolution model output.
de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.result: Abstract not available; the paper reports that online ML inference can be coupled to large ocean simulations on HPC with acceptable overhead.
de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.open_work: Broader use of online ML parameterizations and evaluation of climate impacts of the learned scheme.
de99fb95a126e7fe0ce8bb5c1132a3874e324738.issues: Primarily a software/infrastructure paper; scientific skill of the parameterization is secondary. Details here rely on partial knowledge.

db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.goal: Review AI/ML for forecasting convective weather and hazards (tornadoes, hail, wind, lightning), which are damaging and hard to predict.
db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.architecture: Review covering traditional ML (support vector machines, decision trees, random forests) and deep learning approaches for convective hazards.
db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.data: Review; covered studies use radar, satellite, NWP output and storm reports.
db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.result: Synthesizes the state of the art and highlights challenges across spatial and temporal scales.
db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.open_work: Trustworthy AI usable by forecasters in real time, and cross-sector testbeds to validate ML operationally.
db8a239b92dd67833a0a50054e6d80850ff5b3be.issues: Rapidly evolving field; review is largely US-focused and qualitative.

8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.goal: Review recent and emerging ML applications for climate variability and weather phenomena that cause extremes, following a community workshop.
8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.architecture: Review spanning predictability of climate modes, feature detection, extreme prediction and precursors, observation-model integration, downscaling and bias correction.
8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.data: Review; covered studies use observations, reanalysis and climate model output.
8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.result: Summarizes advances, challenges and research priorities for domain scientists and ML practitioners.
8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.open_work: Research priorities identified include interpretability, uncertainty, and physical consistency.
8b1fa5608d589118c164c609272423f16b10866f.issues: Broad scope with limited depth per topic; qualitative.

652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.goal: Improve operational prediction of tropical cyclone rapid intensification by combining satellite imagery and environmental predictors with deep learning.
652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.architecture: Ensemble of 20 deep-learning models with different network designs and input combinations, predicting 24 h intensity distributions.
652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.data: Satellite images of TC convection plus conventional environmental and TC predictors for western North Pacific TCs.
652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.result: The ensemble achieves higher RI detection probability and lower false-alarm rate than operational forecasts for western Pacific TCs.
652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.open_work: Longer lead times, other basins and calibration of the predicted distributions.
652fb0c10c0ca8e9931e3882a162eaecf0f7d771.issues: Single basin and limited sample of RI events; the ensemble spread is not necessarily calibrated.

db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.goal: Improve ENSO prediction, where dynamical models retain large biases, using a transformer that models 3D upper-ocean and wind fields.
db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.architecture: 3D-Geoformer: a Transformer with time-space self-attention predicting 3D upper-ocean temperature anomalies and wind stress anomalies.
db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.data: Not detailed in the abstract; tropical Pacific ocean temperature and wind stress fields.
db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.result: High correlation skill for Nino 3.4 SST anomalies 18 months ahead, including for spring starts; sensitivity experiments show Bjerknes-feedback-consistent dynamics.
db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.open_work: Extending to other spatiotemporal geoscience problems and real-time forecasting.
db897a3f398d353da49e664d3cd77790739b5ddd.issues: Short observational record limits independent verification; data sources not specified in abstract.

782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.goal: Create a stable, physically consistent ML atmospheric model suitable for climate prediction rather than only weather.
782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.architecture: ACE: a 200M-parameter autoregressive emulator based on Spherical Fourier Neural Operators with 6-hour steps.
782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.data: Output of a comprehensive 100-km global atmospheric model (FV3GFS); tested also with an unseen historical SST dataset (AMIP-style).
782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.result: Stable for 100 years, nearly conserves column moisture, outperforms a challenging baseline on over 90% of variables, and is ~100x faster and more energy efficient.
782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.open_work: Coupling with ocean, responding to CO2 and forcings, and training on observations or reanalysis.
782d8be5b04f6c665568d9dc9d0ee06c00158624.issues: Emulates one model, so inherits its biases; prescribed SST, no forcing change; climate change response untested.

db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.goal: Build an efficient AI-based global ocean model to overcome cost and instability bottlenecks of numerical ocean modelling.
db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.architecture: Fourier-based Masked Autoencoder backbone for basic ocean variables, plus lightweight fine-tuned modules for regional downscaling, wave decoding and biochemistry coupling.
db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.data: Global ocean data at 1/4 degree with 15 depth layers (likely reanalysis; not specified in abstract); regional downscaling to 1/12 degree in the Kuroshio.
db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.result: Best reported performance for 30-day global prediction of basic variables; simulates Kuroshio mesoscale eddies and tropical Pacific stratification.
db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.open_work: Extension to coupled Earth system modeling and longer lead times.
db467127792900ec438884063e61a7957783e1c1.issues: Evaluation details and baselines are unclear from the abstract; preprint; physical consistency not established.

6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.goal: Achieve medium-range global weather forecasts more accurate than the best operational NWP with AI.
6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.architecture: Pangu-Weather: 3D Earth-Specific Transformer with Earth-specific positional bias, plus hierarchical temporal aggregation using models at 1, 3, 6 and 24 h steps.
6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.data: ERA5 at 0.25 degree, 39 years of data (training 1979-2017; testing on 2018).
6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.result: Better deterministic scores than ECMWF operational IFS on all tested variables against reanalysis; also better tropical cyclone tracking than ECMWF-HRES when initialized from reanalysis.
6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.open_work: Operational initial conditions, more variables (e.g. precipitation), and ensembles.
6a78c73c92d5e5d9759b46eff892baf1d6e83754.issues: Evaluated against reanalysis and initialized from reanalysis; smooth forecasts; underestimates extreme intensities; no precipitation output.

23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.goal: Review ML and deep learning for analysis, characterization, prediction and attribution of atmospheric extreme events.
23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.architecture: Review of common ML/DL techniques and literature on extremes, plus a case study on extreme temperature prediction.
23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.data: Review; covers rainfall/floods, heatwaves, droughts, severe weather and fog/low-visibility studies.
23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.result: Provides a critical review and case study, with conclusions and perspectives for the field.
23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.open_work: Outlooks for attribution and interpretability are discussed.
23963af53538bddabe671e58aebc6ec5f9db44eb.issues: Broad scope; case study is illustrative.

e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.goal: Explain why AI weather models become unstable or unphysical on long integrations and propose a remedy.
e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.architecture: Theoretical and numerical analysis linking instability to spectral bias of deep networks, plus a mitigation approach targeting small-scale learning.
e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.data: Quasi-geostrophic turbulence simulations and ERA5 reanalysis.
e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.result: Identifies spectral bias as a universal cause of instability; the proposed solution gives accurate short-term forecasts and stable centuries-long integration with realistic mean and variability.
e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.open_work: Applying the mitigation to full-scale AI weather models and assessing climate change responses.
e1717508e0da9b493419cd9edaf6c3ee18f489fb.issues: Demonstrated on QG and limited ERA5 setting; mitigation may not generalize to all architectures.

874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.goal: Develop a foundation model for weather and climate that can be pretrained on heterogeneous datasets and fine-tuned for many tasks.
874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.architecture: ClimaX: Vision Transformer extended with variable tokenization and variable aggregation, pretrained with self-supervised objectives.
874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.data: Pretraining on CMIP6-derived datasets; fine-tuned on ERA5/WeatherBench forecasting, ClimateBench projections and downscaling at coarse resolutions.
874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.result: Outperforms existing data-driven baselines on weather forecasting and climate projection benchmarks, even with lower resolution and compute.
874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.open_work: Scaling to higher resolution, more data and tasks.
874deb5f06f35e52ae13a921b23611eec4abd1da.issues: Coarse resolution; below operational NWP skill; benefits of pretraining vary by task.

405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.goal: Predict the time remaining until global warming thresholds (1.5 C and 2 C) are reached from observed temperature patterns.
405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.architecture: Neural network trained to predict years-to-threshold from spatial maps of annual temperature anomalies, using transfer learning from climate models to observations.
405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.data: CMIP6 simulations for training; historical temperature observations for out-of-sample prediction.
405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.result: 1.5 C is likely to be reached around the early-to-mid 2030s, even with reduced forcing; there is a possibility of exceeding 2 C even with substantial mitigation.
405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.open_work: Updating predictions as observations accumulate and testing other forcing pathways.
405c320dd7e08e9f3b85ad3b9c506c30c722a5e1.issues: Dependent on CMIP6 training and scenario assumptions; uncertainty in observational datasets.

207c4b5a58d2b47a1e1b5f8a6877018a99f1bf68.goal: Extend observation-based neural weather models beyond 12 h precipitation to 24 h forecasts of multiple surface variables.
207c4b5a58d2b47a1e1b5f8a6877018a99f1bf68.architecture: MetNet-3: neural network combining dense (radar, satellite) and sparse (station) inputs with a densification technique that implicitly captures data assimilation.
207c4b5a58d2b47a1e1b5f8a6877018a99f1bf68.data: CONUS observations: radar, satellite, weather stations and NWP analysis; targets include sparse station observations.
207c4b5a58d2b47a1e1b5f8a6877018a99f1bf68.result: Outperforms HRRR and ENS for precipitation, wind, temperature and dew point up to 24 h, at up to 2-minute and 1 km resolution; operational in Google Search.
207c4b5a58d2b47a1e1b5f8a6877018a99f1bf68.issues: Regional (CONUS); proprietary; evaluation against sparse stations.

cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.goal: Develop a deep-learning model for storm surge forecasting as a fast alternative to numerical surge models.
cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.architecture: Deep learning model (details not available from the abstract).
cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.data: Not reported; likely tide-gauge observations and/or numerical model output with meteorological forcing.
cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.result: Abstract not available; presumably skillful surge prediction at lower cost.
cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.open_work: Generalization to other regions and extreme events.
cb5037411017f8346d6d7a11c271a7dfa8b7238b.issues: Summary inferred from title only; generalization to unprecedented storms is uncertain.

aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.goal: Improve precipitation nowcasting by avoiding blurring, fading high-value echoes and position errors of previous methods.
aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.architecture: DiffCast: residual diffusion framework decomposing evolution into global deterministic motion (any spatiotemporal backbone) plus local stochastic residuals modelled by diffusion.
aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.data: Four public radar datasets (e.g. SEVIR, MeteoNet, Shanghai radar, CIKM).
aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art nowcasting methods across all four datasets.
aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.open_work: Longer lead times and computational efficiency of diffusion sampling.
aae6ba2393bb02cbd8d17d1532e17e34d2ebad8d.issues: Diffusion sampling is slow; radar-only inputs.

5e00e9be5f6ecf05152d608837cf289290635006.goal: Evaluate how well ML weather models forecast a high-impact European windstorm compared with NWP.
5e00e9be5f6ecf05152d608837cf289290635006.architecture: Case-study evaluation of four ML models (FourCastNet, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, FourCastNet-v2) against NWP.
5e00e9be5f6ecf05152d608837cf289290635006.result: ML models capture synoptic structure and jet dynamics but underestimate peak winds; only some resolve the warm seclusion and none capture the sharp bent-back front.
5e00e9be5f6ecf05152d608837cf289290635006.open_work: More case studies of high-impact events and process-based evaluation.
5e00e9be5f6ecf05152d608837cf289290635006.issues: Single case; ML outputs have limited variables and resolution.

25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.goal: Predict ENSO diversity, particularly the onset of strong eastern Pacific El Nino events, and explain predictions.
25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.architecture: Deep learning model (IGP-UHM AI model v1.0) predicting E and C indices with a classification output, plus XAI analysis.
25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.data: Not detailed in abstract; tropical Pacific and global fields; real-time forecast initialized May 2023.
25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.result: Higher ENSO nonlinearity associated with better skill; forecasts El Nino persistence into 2024 with weakening; XAI identifies western Pacific precursors.
25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.open_work: Verification of the 2023-2024 forecast and implications for predictability in a warming climate.
25070d28551b4881bf93cb251c5e220c2f020b61.issues: Limited strong El Nino samples; real-time forecast verification pending.

36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.goal: Improves stochastic ocean mesoscale eddy parameterizations by relaxing the assumption that stochastic residuals are independent between grid points.
36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.architecture: Generative ML models (GAN and VAE) that sample subgrid momentum forcing conditioned on the resolved flow, compared with the Guillaumin and Zanna (2021) mean-plus-variance CNN baseline.
36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.data: High-resolution simulations of an idealized two-layer quasi-geostrophic ocean model (pyqg), filtered and coarse-grained to diagnose subgrid forcing; tested offline and online at several coarse resolutions.
36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.result: Generative models reproduce subgrid forcing and its uncertainty with spatially correlated noise; online they outperform the baseline ML model at the coarsest resolution.
36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.open_work: Extending generative stochastic closures to realistic, primitive-equation ocean models and to temporally correlated noise; reducing sampling cost.
36f36dc574f613a001b7b21a2e115f94ae53a54c.issues: Idealized quasi-geostrophic setting only; the advantage appears mainly at the coarsest resolution; GAN training can be unstable.

ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.goal: Adapts graph-based neural weather prediction, so far mostly global, to limited-area modeling with lateral boundary forcing.
ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.architecture: GraphCast-style graph neural network encoder-processor-decoder on a regional mesh, plus a multi-scale hierarchical graph extension (Hi-LAM); boundaries forced from the driving data.
ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.data: Forecast archive of the MEPS limited-area NWP system over the Nordic region (about 10 km grid), used as training data and verification target.
ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.result: The graph-based models produce skillful regional forecasts, and the hierarchical variant improves on single-level graphs; the abstract gives no quantitative scores.
ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.open_work: Training on analyses or observations instead of model forecasts, probabilistic extensions, and coupling to ML global models for boundaries.
ccb59c308bd6dd73deaad7348b1f2d827205e288.issues: Emulates an existing NWP system rather than observations; boundary conditions taken from the target data in evaluation; deterministic MSE training causes smoothing.

3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.goal: Perspective on how AI and advances in computing can be used to improve climate modeling and prediction.
3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.architecture: Perspective/commentary, not a new model; discusses combining physics-based models, km-scale simulation, and machine learning (e.g., learned parameterizations, emulators).
3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.data: Not applicable (no abstract available); draws on the published literature.
3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.result: Not reported in the abstract (abstract unavailable); argues for a strategic combination of physics, high-resolution simulation, and data-driven learning.
3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.open_work: Building community infrastructure and hybrid physics-ML models that remain trustworthy for climate projections.
3954f293ed835c76dfdaca98bc5c09d65cd5a02c.issues: Opinion piece; content inferred from the title and author group, so the card should be checked against the full text.

affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.goal: Tests whether a CNN-based stochastic mesoscale eddy parameterization can be implemented and used like a conventional parameterization in an ocean GCM.
affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.architecture: The Guillaumin and Zanna (2021) deep CNN predicting mean and variance of subgrid momentum forcing, implemented online in the MOM6 ocean model.
affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.data: Parameterization trained on coarse-grained high-resolution CM2.6 data; evaluated online in idealized MOM6 configurations (e.g., double gyre and NeverWorld2) at several resolutions.
affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.result: The parameterization is stable without modification, injects energy and improves backscatter, and its effect diminishes as resolution increases; it needs depth-dependent tuning, is weaker near boundaries, and is prohibitively costly on CPUs.
affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.open_work: Retraining with boundaries and vertical structure, cheaper inference (e.g., GPUs or smaller networks), and testing in realistic climate configurations.
affc708a6c1eb25f60a8c6a3ddc935ded7331f67.issues: Idealized configurations only; requires ad hoc tuning; high computational cost; generalization to a different model and regime is only partly successful.

deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.goal: Develops a generative precipitation nowcasting model with better-calibrated uncertainty and more stable training than GANs.
deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.architecture: Latent diffusion model (LDCast): an autoencoder compresses radar sequences and a conditional diffusion model generates future latent states.
deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.data: Radar-based precipitation composites from MeteoSwiss over Switzerland and the surrounding region; benchmarked against DGMR and PySTEPS.
deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.result: The LDM gives more accurate precipitation predictions and more diverse ensembles than DGMR or PySTEPS; rank histograms show well-calibrated spread, while threshold exceedance scores are mixed.
deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.open_work: Faster sampling, longer lead times, and use of extra inputs (satellite, NWP) and other regions.
deb5064b21b8a7f1d4392f90c0818e1b67e40963.issues: Generation is computationally expensive; threshold-based skill is not clearly better; results are for one radar domain.

33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.goal: Builds a machine learning model that beats operational deterministic NWP for global medium-range forecasting at 0.25 degrees.
33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.architecture: GraphCast: graph neural network encoder-processor-decoder on an icosahedral multimesh, autoregressive with 6 h steps, about 37M parameters.
33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.data: ERA5 0.25 degrees, 37 pressure levels; trained on 1979-2017 and tested on 2018 against ECMWF HRES (verified against HRES analysis at t=0).
33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.result: Outperforms HRES on 90% of 1380 verification targets for 10-day forecasts, produced in under one minute on a single TPU; better tropical cyclone tracks, atmospheric rivers, and extreme temperatures.
33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.open_work: Probabilistic forecasts, reduced blurring at long leads, and operational use with real-time analyses.
33ed3d9a505131daf631ca5fa1307e3aafdd3343.issues: Deterministic MSE training leads to smoothing at long lead times; trained on reanalysis so inherits its biases; underestimates tropical cyclone intensity; relies on NWP-based initial conditions.

6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.goal: Surveys ML methods for weather and climate prediction across time scales, aiming to link short-term weather and long-term climate forecasting.
6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.architecture: Literature survey of more than 20 methods, highlighting eight promising techniques for short-term weather and medium-to-long-term climate prediction.
6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.data: Not applicable; based on published studies.
6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.result: ML is strong for short-term weather prediction but remains limited for medium-to-long-term climate forecasting because of complex variables and data limitations.
6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.open_work: Integrating models across time scales and paying more attention to model structure and recent advances.
6e4f906e63cd975d9856924651bdd1f4a9ba1125.issues: Broad survey with limited depth; selection criteria for the eight techniques are not clear from the abstract.

4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.goal: Reviews how machine learning is combined with data assimilation and uncertainty quantification for high-dimensional dynamical systems.
4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.architecture: Review covering ML for system identification, reduced-order surrogate models, error covariance specification, and model error correction within DA and UQ.
4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.data: Not applicable; covers applications from computational fluid dynamics to geoscience and climate.
4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.result: Provides a structured overview of how ML can address limits of DA and UQ and how DA and UQ can improve ML accuracy and interpretability.
4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.open_work: Perspectives on further integration of ML with DA and UQ, including scalability to operational systems.
4dca7d792af3820cb2ea3ed4695536e9cf04321b.issues: Broad scope across disciplines, so atmospheric- and ocean-specific depth is limited.

d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.goal: Combines physics-based dynamics with ML to achieve skillful weather and ensemble forecasts and stable long climate simulations.
d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.architecture: NeuralGCM: differentiable spectral dynamical core coupled with a neural network that learns physics tendencies, trained end to end over multi-step rollouts; deterministic and stochastic versions.
d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.data: ERA5 reanalysis at 2.8, 1.4, and 0.7 degree resolutions; evaluated with WeatherBench 2 on 2020; AMIP-style multi-decade runs with prescribed SST.
d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.result: Competitive with ML models at 1-10 days and with the ECMWF ensemble at 1-15 days; tracks climate metrics for decades and produces realistic tropical cyclones at 140 km resolution, with large computational savings.
d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.open_work: Coupling to ocean and land models, and improving generalization to climates different from the training period.
d035359d8ed1e89db5eb5b2455215a69f276ed94.issues: Does not extrapolate to substantially different future climates; trained on reanalysis; some runs become unstable over long integrations.

5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.goal: Builds a fast neural-operator emulator for regional sea surface height forecasting where ocean ML faces bathymetry, coastlines, and nonlinear flow.
5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.architecture: OceanNet: Fourier neural operator with a predictor-evaluate-corrector time integration scheme and a spectral regularizer to limit autoregressive error growth and spectral bias.
5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.data: Historical SSH data for the northwest Atlantic (Gulf Stream) and Gulf of Mexico (Loop Current eddies); compared with a dynamical ocean model forecast.
5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.result: Seasonal SSH forecast skill competitive with a state-of-the-art dynamical ocean model at about 500,000 times lower computational cost.
5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.open_work: Extending to 3D ocean state, more variables, and coupling with atmospheric forcing or data assimilation.
5af3db4a1738b321c9effc04b34c055c62f6a472.issues: Only SSH is emulated; regional and seasonal scope; no explicit uncertainty quantification.

0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.goal: Improves SST prediction by transferring physical knowledge learned from historical observations into numerical model output.
0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.architecture: Encoder combined with a generative adversarial network trained on observations; numerical model data are passed through it to create physics-enhanced fields used for SST prediction.
0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.data: Historical SST observations and numerical model SST data; specific products and regions are not reported in the abstract.
0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.result: Reports considerably better SST prediction than several state-of-the-art baselines; numbers are not given in the abstract.
0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.open_work: Testing across regions and lead times and with other ocean variables.
0e1bb7c1962ac326635c6240983c44a5aab31ece.issues: Unclear what physical knowledge the GAN actually transfers; dataset and evaluation details not given in the abstract; risk of overfitting to observation-era statistics.

599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.goal: Gives timely, low-cost predictions of regional heatwave occurrence for preparedness.
599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.architecture: Graph neural network over a network of weather stations, with an interpretable structure that reveals spatiotemporal links between locations.
599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.data: Weather station observations; the region and period are not reported in the abstract.
599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.result: Reports high-accuracy real-time warnings of sudden regional heatwaves at low computational and data cost; no numbers in the abstract.
599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.open_work: Applying the framework to other extreme and compound climate events.
599b1c3716ce0d63e1eb93a3427ea544560038e1.issues: Station-based, so spatial coverage depends on the network; comparison baselines and lead times are unclear from the abstract; causal interpretation of graph weights needs caution.

521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.goal: Provides cost-effective km-scale downscaling of coarse global data as an alternative to expensive km-scale simulation.
521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.architecture: CorrDiff: two-step model in which a UNet regresses the conditional mean and a score-based diffusion model generates the residual.
521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.data: 25 km ERA5 as input and 2 km operational regional WRF output over Taiwan as target; about three years of training data with a held-out year for testing.
521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.result: Good deterministic and probabilistic skill, recovers power-law spectra and distributions, sharpens cold fronts, intensifies typhoons, and synthesizes rainbands.
521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.open_work: Better calibration of uncertainty and coupling with coarse global ML models for global-to-regional simulation.
521e64284990705cc5049c300ae7b98d83c03532.issues: Uncertainty calibration remains challenging (under-dispersed); single region and short training record; target is a model, not observations.

436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.goal: Improves nowcasting of extreme precipitation, where physics-based models and pure deep learning both fail (blur, dissipation, intensity and location errors).
436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.architecture: NowcastNet: neural evolution operator enforcing advective physics combined with a conditional generative (GAN-type) network for multiscale details, trained end to end.
436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.data: Radar observations from the USA and China; forecasts over 2048 km x 2048 km domains with lead times up to 3 h.
436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.result: Produces sharp, physically plausible nowcasts; in an evaluation by 62 professional meteorologists it ranked first in 71% of cases against leading methods.
436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.open_work: Extending lead times beyond 3 h and including other data such as satellite or NWP.
436e2e51204e242d7064de52aa6766037265c45a.issues: Subjective expert evaluation is central; generative outputs may not be calibrated probabilistically; limited to radar-observable precipitation.

f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.goal: Removes the flat-geometry artifacts and dissipation of Fourier neural operators when learning dynamics on the sphere.
f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.architecture: Spherical Fourier Neural Operator (SFNO), which replaces the discrete Fourier transform with spherical harmonic transforms for rotation-equivariant global convolutions.
f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.data: Shallow-water equations on the sphere and ERA5 reanalysis for atmospheric forecasting.
f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.result: Stable autoregressive rollouts for a year of simulated time (1,460 six-hour steps) with physically plausible dynamics, avoiding the artifacts of standard FNOs.
f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.open_work: Use for long climate simulations and coupled Earth system emulation.
f3338a66e93b62d60ee01aa00ed798c9cc9582d9.issues: Stability is shown but long rollouts still smooth small scales; deterministic training; skill comparisons with operational systems are limited.

b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.goal: Improves gridded SSH maps from sparse along-track altimetry, which optimal interpolation over-smooths in energetic regions.
b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.architecture: Deep neural network that reconstructs 2D SSH by combining along-track altimetry with SST observations.
b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.data: Satellite along-track altimetry and satellite SST in the Gulf Stream Extension region; evaluated against withheld altimeter observations and surface drifters.
b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.result: 17% lower RMSE than optimal interpolation and resolves spatial scales 30% smaller; geostrophic currents agree better with drifters and change estimates of eddy kinetic energy, vorticity, and strain.
b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.open_work: Producing a global SSH product with the method.
b6c88a0f06b6b6d8c247f02a80d5e4ce92a144dc.issues: Shown for one region; relies on SST-SSH relationships that weaken where SST gradients are weak or clouds block SST.

2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.goal: Extends skillful global medium-range deterministic forecasts beyond 10 days and adds probabilistic forecasting.
2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.architecture: FengWu: transformer-based multi-modal, multi-task model with a replay buffer to reduce error accumulation; FengWu-Ensemble uses a conditional diffusion model on deterministic forecasts.
2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.data: ERA5 at 0.25 degrees on 13 pressure levels; compared with ECMWF HRES, Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and the IFS ensemble.
2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.result: Outperforms HRES, Pangu-Weather, and GraphCast deterministically, with skillful forecasts beyond 10 days; FengWu-Ensemble beats the IFS ensemble on several variables and metrics.
2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.open_work: Higher resolution, more variables, and operational initialization from real-time analyses.
2b344095e31a27fcf02b86196f128745a4746b04.issues: Trained and verified against ERA5; deterministic forecasts likely smooth at long leads; ensemble built on deterministic output may limit spread realism.

1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.goal: Assesses for the first time an ML weather model against operational NWP in an operational-like setup with identical initial conditions.
1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.architecture: Verification study (not a new model) comparing Pangu-Weather with the ECMWF IFS using standard forecast verification tools.
1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.data: Pangu-Weather and IFS forecasts initialized from the operational IFS analysis; verified against IFS analysis and synoptic observations.
1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.result: Comparable accuracy for global metrics and extreme events; drawbacks are overly smooth fields, bias growing with lead time, and poor tropical cyclone intensity.
1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.open_work: Probabilistic ML forecasts and operational integration of ML models initialized from analyses.
1589a956da3e5c88be133477d743f7781b23b92c.issues: Deterministic only; one ML model; evaluation partly against the IFS analysis, which favors IFS.

f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.goal: Provides a common, updated benchmark to compare data-driven and physical global medium-range weather models fairly.
f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.architecture: Benchmark: open-source evaluation framework, public training, ground-truth and baseline data, headline scores, and a continuously updated website.
f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.data: ERA5 and operational analyses as ground truth; forecasts from IFS HRES and ENS and ML models such as Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and others, mainly for 2020.
f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.result: Defines headline scores following operational practice and presents results for state-of-the-art physical and ML models.
f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.open_work: Better probabilistic and extreme-event evaluation, observation-based verification, and handling of caveats such as differing initial conditions.
f46239e42370b0370427bfddda70869ca09fc758.issues: Verification against reanalysis or each model's own analysis can bias comparisons; standard metrics reward smooth forecasts.

5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.goal: Builds an efficient deep learning Earth system model that simulates the current climate stably for long periods.
5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.architecture: DLESyM: coupled atmosphere and ocean deep learning model (convolutional networks on a HEALPix mesh) for atmosphere state and SST.
5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.data: Historical reanalysis and satellite observations; compared with historical simulations from four CMIP6 models.
5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.result: Stable 1000-year simulations with little smoothing or drift; matches or beats CMIP6 models for tropical cyclogenesis, the Indian summer monsoon cycle, and mid-latitude blocking climatology.
5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.open_work: Use for subseasonal and seasonal forecasting and extension to forced climate change.
5fa39247b13268ad1cc69e69821e2335ed71cf02.issues: Simulates current climate only, not forced changes; limited set of variables; inherits reanalysis biases.

b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.goal: Develops a foundation model for the Earth system that can be fine-tuned cheaply for diverse forecasting tasks.
b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.architecture: Aurora: about 1.3B-parameter model with a Perceiver-style encoder and decoder around a 3D Swin transformer backbone; pretrained, then fine-tuned per task.
b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.data: Over a million hours of diverse data (reanalyses, forecasts, climate simulations); fine-tuned for air quality (CAMS), ocean waves, tropical cyclone tracks, and 0.1 degree weather.
b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.result: Outperforms operational forecasts for air quality, ocean waves, tropical cyclone tracks, and high-resolution weather at much lower computational cost.
b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.open_work: More domains and better understanding of which pretraining data drive the gains.
b624cf23d5e621eab085f28aabf5e4db59b2a501.issues: Pretraining is very expensive; deterministic forecasts; fine-tuning targets are often model analyses rather than observations.

74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.goal: Provides a fair, parameter-free way to compare the probabilistic skill of AI weather models.
74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.architecture: Benchmark method that scores lagged initial-condition ensembles built from libraries of deterministic hindcasts.
74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.data: Deterministic hindcasts from GraphCast and Pangu-Weather and an operational baseline, verified against reanalysis.
74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.result: Lagged ensembles of GraphCast and Pangu perform similarly even though GraphCast is better deterministically; multi-time-step loss functions damage ensemble calibration.
74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.open_work: Applying the benchmark to more models and to genuinely probabilistic AI ensembles.
74b6edcb5384c41c5d0bded6ef22d3dcfd575a81.issues: Lagged ensembles are a proxy and not how operational ensembles are made; results depend on hindcast library.

5c3086f93b79b90d264042df415ad80b63ff5557.goal: Reviews ML for air quality modeling with a focus on issues the literature tends to overlook.
5c3086f93b79b90d264042df415ad80b63ff5557.architecture: Review article; abstract unavailable, so scope is inferred from the title.
5c3086f93b79b90d264042df415ad80b63ff5557.data: Not applicable; based on published air quality ML studies.
5c3086f93b79b90d264042df415ad80b63ff5557.open_work: Likely concerns validation practice, generalization, and interpretability; check the full text.
5c3086f93b79b90d264042df415ad80b63ff5557.issues: Card is based on the title only.

5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.goal: Builds an ML atmosphere emulator that responds to external forcings (SST, greenhouse gases) and reproduces variability from days to decades.
5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.architecture: ACE2: 450M-parameter autoregressive emulator (Spherical Fourier Neural Operator based) with 6 h steps, 1 degree resolution, and eight vertical layers; exactly conserves dry air mass and moisture.
5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.data: ERA5 reanalysis over about 80 years, forced by SST and CO2.
5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.result: Stable for arbitrarily long runs at about 1500 simulated years per day; produces tropical cyclones, the MJO, and sudden stratospheric warmings; reproduces ENSO responses and 80-year temperature trends.
5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.open_work: Fixing unrealistic separate sensitivities to SST and CO2, and coupling to ocean models.
5d09f19cd903fbf4f6dde7753cefdd25da684593.issues: Sensitivities to SST and CO2 changes individually are not realistic; coarse vertical resolution; inherits reanalysis biases.

6d33257874246e35a67f1a6e80f6b307952c2e2e.goal: Perspective on using AI with multiscale climate models to better support mitigation and adaptation.
6d33257874246e35a67f1a6e80f6b307952c2e2e.architecture: Perspective; abstract unavailable. Discusses hybrid physics-AI climate modeling and km-scale simulation.
6d33257874246e35a67f1a6e80f6b307952c2e2e.open_work: Developing hybrid models that are physically consistent, interpretable, and useful for regional adaptation.
6d33257874246e35a67f1a6e80f6b307952c2e2e.issues: Card is based on the title and author group only.

e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.goal: Describes ECMWF's operational data-driven global medium-range forecasting system.
e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.architecture: AIFS: graph neural network encoder and decoder with a sliding-window transformer processor; modular design with several levels of parallelism.
e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.data: ERA5 reanalysis and ECMWF operational NWP analyses; verified against analyses and observations.
e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.result: Highly skilled forecasts for upper-air variables, surface weather parameters, and tropical cyclone tracks; runs four times daily with open data.
e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.open_work: Probabilistic versions, higher resolution, and more variables.
e8d9f8e79024753f68ff8883c49f2d1644ef9c56.issues: Deterministic version tends to smooth; depends on NWP analyses for initialization; much verification is against ECMWF's own analysis.

ba9c1a54a8995df8bb79a6a848055d491049898f.goal: Builds an ML ensemble forecasting system that gives calibrated probabilistic forecasts.
ba9c1a54a8995df8bb79a6a848055d491049898f.architecture: AIFS-CRPS: stochastic AIFS variant trained with an almost fair CRPS loss that corrects for finite ensemble size; generates any number of exchangeable members.
ba9c1a54a8995df8bb79a6a848055d491049898f.data: ERA5 and ECMWF operational analyses; compared with the IFS ensemble for medium-range and subseasonal leads.
